Hairstyling and Aesthetics applications should improve consultation, organization, ergonomics, and workflow while respecting infection-prevention practices. Fabricated classroom prototypes do not make a material heat-safe, disinfectable, or suitable for direct client contact.

::: {.ter-curriculum-relevance}
**Important boundary:** Keep unverified laser-cut wood, porous prints, and unknown plastics away from hot tools, chemicals, wet service, and items that must be disinfected or sterilized. Follow product instructions, public-health guidance, board policy, and local salon procedures.
:::

## Project directions

:::: {.ter-project-grid}
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Consultation colour-ring display
<p class="ter-course-code">TXJ2O / TXJ3E · Display family</p>
Design a stable system that organizes removable colour samples and supports a clear client conversation.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Consultation observation → grouping study → mock-up → reach/readability test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Colour organization, labels, ergonomics, client communication</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Introductory–intermediate · tabletop</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Non-service display materials; removable commercial sample rings</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Prevent tipping and sample tangling</dd><dt>Use boundary</dt><dd>Display only; no chemical mixing, hot-tool, or sanitized-service use</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hairstyling-aesthetics&type=project-components">Display and tag components</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../02-digital-design/04-layout-typography-colour.qmd">Layout, Type & Colour</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Create an inclusive consultation guide for varied hair characteristics</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Dry-tool workstation organizer
<p class="ter-course-code">TXJ2O · Organizer family</p>
Organize clean, dry, room-temperature practice items so inventory and workflow are visible.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Inventory → grip/reach measurement → cardboard trial → dry-use prototype</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Workflow, clearance, labels, centre of mass, cleaning assessment</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · bounded desktop module</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Prototype material separated from disinfection-required items</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Wide base; no wall load without approved mounting</dd><dt>Use boundary</dt><dd>No hot irons, blades, wet implements, chemicals, or sterilization claims</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hairstyling-aesthetics&type=tool-holders">Relevant dry-tool rack forms</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../03-laser-cutting/06-tool-holder.qmd">Tool Holder</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Redesign the geometry in a verified non-porous material</dd></dl>
:::
::: {.ter-project-card}
### Portable consultation module
<p class="ter-course-code">TXJ3E / TXJ4E · Portable work module</p>
Create a compact module for forms, reference images, clean sample materials, and privacy-conscious note taking.
<dl><dt>Process</dt><dd>Service journey → information inventory → privacy review → prototype → setup test</dd><dt>Skills</dt><dd>Client-centred design, compartments, handles, visual communication</dd><dt>Difficulty / size</dt><dd>Intermediate · lap or tabletop scale</dd><dt>Material</dt><dd>Wipeable commercial case with fabricated non-clinical dividers</dd><dt>Structural</dt><dd>Retain contents during transport; avoid exposed fasteners</dd><dt>Use boundary</dt><dd>Do not store chemicals or personal client records in an unsecured prototype</dd><dt>Library</dt><dd><a href="../../../teaching-materials/laser-cutting/?technology=hairstyling-aesthetics&type=french-cleat">Modular faces and dividers</a></dd><dt>Lesson</dt><dd><a href="../../01-nice-design-process/01-needs-necessities.qmd">Needs & Necessities</a></dd><dt>Extension</dt><dd>Conduct a timed setup and revise the sequence</dd></dl>
:::
::::
